summary: Team17's Worms series began as a 1995 turn-based artillery tactics game and later expanded into many sequels, remakes, and anniversary releases.

entries.title: Worms
entries.definitive_edition: Worms United for current classic PC completeness

emulation.notes: Use current PC package for normal access; original hardware/emulation for strict history.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Worms United or original Amiga/DOS route with version documented

primary.why: Worms United combines the original PC game with the Reinforcements expansion and is the most practical complete classic PC route. The Amiga original and console ports are important for version comparison, while later Worms remakes/sequels are separate entries.
primary.how_to_play: Use Worms United from GOG/Steam if available, or original DOS/Amiga capture for strict history. Record version, expansion state, scheme/weapons, team names, terrain seed, turn time, multiplayer/hotseat state, soundbank, and platform.

secondary.why: Worms United is the best current complete PC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record scheme, terrain seed, expansion state, and multiplayer setup.

entries.title: Worms World Party
entries.definitive_edition: Worms World Party Remastered for current capture; original PC build for exact historical behavior

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; console/handheld emulation only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC remaster capture or original PC build behavior

primary.version: Worms World Party Remastered / current PC route
primary.why: Worms World Party is best archived on PC, and the Remastered/current route is the practical storefront path while the original 2001 build remains important for exact physics/UI/network behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Worms World Party Remastered or an owned original PC copy. Record version, resolution, team/settings, weapon scheme, mission/training progress, network/multiplayer state, and whether Dreamcast or handheld versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving the 2001 build exactly.
secondary.why: The remastered route is practical, but old build behavior can matter.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether Remastered or original build was used and preserve scheme/team settings.
